mapper.insert: insert ignore into vpn.user_reward_ticket(user_name, transaction_id, granted, created_at, expire_at) values(#{name}, #{tx}, #{granted}, #{createdAt}, #{expireAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) from vpn.user_reward_ticket where user_name=#{name} and granted=1 and created_at >= #{since}
select max(created_at) from vpn.user_reward_ticket where user_name=#{name} and granted=1
select count(*) from vpn.user_reward_ticket where user_name=#{name} and granted=1 and used=0 and expire_at > #{now}
mapper.update: update vpn.user_reward_ticket set used=1 where id in #{id}
